pages.text: Draw a small circle with Phasing Chalk. Offer either one bound Waystone or one bound Taglock. A Waystone targets its saved position; a Taglock targets its living, loaded owner at completion. Both destinations must be in the current dimension.

The cast takes five seconds, costs 450 starting power and 20 each second: 550 total, or 482 with Hecate's Visage. It moves every entity in the focal block's box expanded three blocks in every direction to the destination center.

The landing area must already be loaded, within the world border, dry, clear of blocks and supported by solid ground. Every traveler must fit. Passengers and vehicles prevent the whole cast. Destination and travelers are checked before payment and again at completion.

Success consumes a Taglock or one Waystone use. A surviving Waystone stays in the focal glyph; shift-click the glyph to retrieve it. Failure or cancellation returns the original offering without wear, but spent power is not refunded. Athame kills of Endermen or Endermites supply Dimensional Sand for $(l:sympathy/advanced_chalk)Phasing Chalk$(). This ritual does not enable remote casting.
